title: Raccoon eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#8b8fa8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#d8dbe8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='22' fill='#9a9eb8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='27' r='8' fill='#7d8199'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='27' r='4' fill='#c9a0b8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='27' r='8' fill='#7d8199'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='27' r='4' fill='#c9a0b8'/>
  <!-- dark mask around eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#4b4f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='42' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#4b4f6b'/>
  <!-- white eyebrow patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='34' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#e8eaf4'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='34' rx='9' ry='4' fill='#e8eaf4'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='4' fill='#1e2233'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='42' r='4' fill='#1e2233'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='40.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#e8eaf4'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2a2e45'/>
  <!-- mouth open eating -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#5c3040'/>
  <!-- paws holding snack -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='66' r='5' fill='#7d8199'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='66' r='5' fill='#7d8199'/>
  <!-- snack: a cookie -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='66' r='7' fill='#d9a05b'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='64' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a20'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='64' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a20'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='69' r='1.3' fill='#7a4a20'/>
  <!-- striped tail -->
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='80' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#7d8199'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='75' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#4b4f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='83' rx='7' ry='3' fill='#4b4f6b'/>
  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='60' r='1' fill='#d9a05b'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='61' r='1' fill='#d9a05b'/>
</svg>
